title: Towards Hierarchical Multi-Step Reward Models for Enhanced Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors_zh: Teng Wang、Jiang Zhangyi、Zhenqi He、Hailei Gong、Shenyang Tong、Wenhan Yang、Zeyu Li、Yanan Zheng、Zifan He、Zewen Ye、Shengjie Ma、Jianping Zhang
paper_type_zh: 过程奖励模型与多步监督论文
best_for_zh: 研究 PRM 训练样本、步骤标签与推理过程奖励的读者。
one_line: HRM scores individual and consecutive reasoning steps and augments process-supervision data through hierarchical node compression.
HRM 同时判断单个步骤和连续步骤，并以节点压缩扩充过程监督数据来训练更稳健的奖励模型。
why: It makes the link between an explicit data object and a training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: The paper changes how a training record, selection signal, reward, or trajectory is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A conventional process reward model judges one reasoning step at a time. That local view can penalize a step that is later repaired, or reward a plausible-looking step even though the surrounding multi-step argument has already lost coherence.

The paper asks how process supervision can represent both local quality and consecutive reasoning context without relying only on costly new annotations. It answers with a hierarchical reward model and a data-augmentation procedure that derives additional multi-step supervision from reasoning trees.

传统过程奖励模型一次只判断一个推理步骤。这种局部视角可能惩罚后来被修正的步骤，也可能奖励表面合理的步骤，即使周围的多步论证早已失去连贯性。

本文追问：过程监督怎样同时表示局部质量和连续推理语境，而不只依赖昂贵的新标注。其答案是层次化奖励模型，以及一种从推理树中派生额外多步监督的数据扩充过程。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central training object is a labelled reasoning trajectory viewed at two scales. One view is an individual step; the other is a consecutive segment that supplies context for judging whether an apparent error is followed by a meaningful correction.

Hierarchical Node Compression creates the second view by merging adjacent nodes in a reasoning tree. The resulting records allow the hierarchical reward model to learn fine-grained and coarse-grained judgements together, changing the supervision unit rather than only changing the search algorithm used at inference time.

核心训练对象是以两种尺度观察的带标签推理轨迹。一种视角是单个步骤；另一种是连续片段，它为判断表面错误之后是否出现有意义的修正提供语境。

层次化节点压缩通过合并推理树中相邻节点来创建第二种视角。由此得到的记录使层次化奖励模型能够同时学习细粒度和粗粒度判断，改变的是监督单元，而不只是推理时使用的搜索算法。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method starts from reasoning-tree paths and process labels generated or organized for the reward-model training setting. Hierarchical Node Compression merges consecutive nodes, producing additional examples that contain a compressed multi-step segment while preserving their relation to the original path.

The hierarchical reward model is trained to evaluate both isolated steps and consecutive segments. At use time, this permits a process judgement to reflect local correctness together with nearby context. The paper studies the procedure on PRM800K and evaluates the resulting reward behaviour on mathematical-reasoning tasks.

该方法从为奖励模型训练生成或整理的推理树路径和过程标签出发。层次化节点压缩合并连续节点，产生包含压缩多步片段的额外样本，同时保留它们与原始路径的关系。

层次化奖励模型同时学习评估孤立步骤和连续片段。使用时，这使过程判断既能反映局部正确性，也能反映相邻语境。论文在 PRM800K 上研究该过程，并在数学推理任务上评测得到的奖励行为。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On PRM800K, the authors report that the hierarchical model with node compression gives more stable and reliable evaluation than the process-reward-model comparisons used in the paper. They also use tests on MATH500 and GSM8K to argue that the resulting reward behaviour generalizes across mathematical-reasoning datasets.

The evidence is bounded by the paper's mathematical setting, its tree construction, and its process labels. It supports the claim that multi-scale supervision can improve reward evaluation there; it does not establish that a high process reward is a formal proof of correctness in another domain.

在 PRM800K 上，作者报告层次化模型加节点压缩比论文采用的过程奖励模型对照具有更稳定、更可靠的评测表现。他们还使用 MATH500 和 GSM8K 的测试说明，得到的奖励行为能够跨数学推理数据集泛化。

证据受限于论文的数学场景、推理树构造方式和过程标签。它支持多尺度监督能在那里改进奖励评估的主张；它并不说明在其他领域获得高过程奖励就等于形式化证明正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most process reward models use an isolated step as their basic supervision unit, while automatic tree expansion is often pursued mainly to produce more individual labels. This leaves the model with little direct representation of how neighbouring steps alter the meaning of an earlier step.

The contribution combines a hierarchical reward model with node compression so that one training collection contains both step-level and compressed consecutive-step records. The novelty lies in altering the process-supervision data and its training target, not merely in replacing the reinforcement-learning optimizer.

大多数过程奖励模型把孤立步骤作为基本监督单元，而自动扩展推理树通常主要是为了产生更多单独标签。这使模型几乎没有直接表示相邻步骤如何改变先前步骤含义的能力。

本文把层次化奖励模型与节点压缩结合，使一份训练集合同时包含步骤级记录和压缩后的连续步骤记录。新意在于改变过程监督数据及其训练目标，而不只是替换强化学习优化器。

title: Limitations
局限
html: HNC deliberately introduces controlled noise and inherits the reliability limits of MCTS labels. Users should test whether node merging changes semantics in their domain and should not treat a high reward as proof of a formally valid derivation.
HNC 有意引入受控噪声，也继承 MCTS 标签的可靠性边界。使用者应检验节点合并是否改变本领域的语义，且不能把高过程奖励当作推导必然有效的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a PRM must distinguish an isolated error from a self-corrected sequence: retain tree structure, construct a held-out set of step segments, and compare isolated-step, consecutive-step, and answer-level rewards.
当 PRM 需要区分孤立错误与随后被纠正的序列时，可保留树结构、构造留出的步骤片段，并比较孤立步骤、连续步骤和答案级奖励；如果没有可信过程标签或合并会损失语义，则不应直接使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The practical handle is the changed supervision unit: one step plus its compressed context. Evidence comes from PRM800K and cross-domain math tests; the first reuse check is whether your labels and merging policy preserve meaning.
实践抓手是改变监督单元：一个步骤及其压缩上下文。证据来自 PRM800K 与跨数学数据集测试；复用前先确认标签和节点合并策略是否保持原意。
